overview:
The **Battle of Manaan (Great War)** (3641 BBY) was a pivotal engagement of the **Great War (SWTOR)**, fought on or above **Manaan**. Underwater battle for manaan kolto fields with republic submarines engaging imperial depth charges near ahto city domes.

Archives record this battle across saga films, animated series, Knights of the Old Republic, Old Sith Empire chronicles, and expanded universe sources — anchoring the Great War (SWTOR) in both cinematic canon and deep galactic history.
history:
Military historians of the New Republic classify the Battle of Manaan (Great War) within the broader **Great War (SWTOR)** campaign. Front-line reports describe underwater battle for manaan kolto fields with republic submarines engaging imperial depth charges near ahto city domes.

Commanders on both sides leveraged local terrain, orbital support, and Force-sensitive operatives where available. The engagement's outcome shifted regional control and fed into later battles documented across the same war.

For chronology enthusiasts, **3641 BBY** places this conflict in the galactic timeline alongside other famous battles of the Great War (SWTOR).
significance: The Battle of Manaan (Great War) illustrates how the Great War (SWTOR) reshaped the galaxy — through combined arms warfare, political betrayal, and the eternal struggle between light and dark. Its legacy persists in memorials, veteran accounts, and holodramas spanning nine saga films and decades of tie-in fiction.
